name: Oryctodromeus
sum: A small orodromine thescelosaurid whose name means "digger runner", the first dinosaur with trace and body fossil evidence of burrowing.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; named by Varricchio and colleagues in 2007.
